State Programme guide · based on 2026/27 data

Study abroad with state funding: are you eligible?

The "State Programme for study abroad" (2022–2028) pays your tuition fees, monthly living costs, visa, insurance and flights. Check your eligibility with a 2-minute test, find programmes that suit you and work out roughly how much the state will pay for you.

How does the programme work?

The most important rule: the state doesn’t find you a university. First you get an offer from a university on the list yourself, then the state covers the costs.

  1. Pick a university and programme from the listThe 2026/27 list has ~4 100 programmes in 15 fields. Programmes not on the list aren’t funded.

  2. Apply to the university and get an offerApplications usually run from November to March. A conditional offer is accepted only in certain cases.

  3. C1-level language certificateIELTS (7.0+), TOEFL iBT (5.0+, new 1–6 scale), Duolingo (130+), etc. For a Bachelor’s it isn’t required if you have IB / A-level / AP results.

  4. Apply to the State Programme on portal.edu.azApril–JuneDocuments are uploaded in PDF format. The deadline for 2026/27 was 05.06.2026.

  5. InterviewThe commission assesses your subject knowledge, logical thinking and communication. The pass mark is 40 out of 50.

  6. Contract and fundingTuition fees, monthly living costs, visa, health insurance, flights and bank fees are covered.

    Good to know

    The 6 things people ask most before applying. More details: the questions section below and dp.edu.az.

    Which language certificate counts?C1 in the language of instruction: IELTS 7.0+, TOEFL iBT 5.0+ (new 1–6 scale), Duolingo 130+ or another C1 certificate. For a Bachelor’s, no certificate is needed if you have IB / A-level / AP.
    What is an unconditional offer?For the DP, your final letter must be an unconditional offer. A conditional offer is accepted only in some cases; an offer with a language condition is not accepted.
    Top-10 exceptionAt universities in the world top 10 (THE, QS, ARWU), programmes not on the list are also funded (UCL excepted).
    The interview is decisiveAfter your documents are accepted there is an interview about your major, motivation and future plans. International olympiad medallists are exempt from the interview.
    Foundation is not fundedFoundation and language courses are not paid for. The Programme covers only full-time Bachelor’s, Master’s and doctoral programmes on the list.
    Military documentMale applicants submit a military ID or a deferment certificate (ASAN service). Get it ready in good time.

    Timeline for September 2027

    Dates are based on previous years and are approximate; follow the official announcement on dp.edu.az.

    1. NOW – DECEMBER 2026Choosing a university and programme, IELTS / TOEFL preparation

      Pick 3–5 programmes from the list and start language preparation for C1.

    2. NOVEMBER 2026 – MARCH 2027Applying to universities

      Motivation letter, CV, recommendations. Goal: getting an offer letter.

    3. MARCH – APRIL 2027Preparing your DP documents

      2 recommendation letters (addressed to the Ministry), health certificate (AZS-086/1), military document, transcript (GPA (ÜOMG)), language certificate.

    4. APRIL – JUNE 2027Applying to the State Programme (portal.edu.az)

      As soon as the call opens, upload your documents in PDF format. In 2026 the deadline was 5 June.

    5. JUNE – AUGUST 2027Interview, result, contract and visa

      Prepare for the interview: your major, motivation, future plans.

    6. SEPTEMBER 2027Start of studies

      Your scholarship card is activated and monthly living costs are paid.

    Frequently asked questions

    Does the state find me a university?

    No. The programme doesn’t handle university admission. First you get an offer from a university on the list yourself (or you’re already studying there), then the state pays your tuition and living costs. You can’t submit documents without an offer letter.

    I don’t have a language certificate. Can I apply?

    You’re exempt from the language certificate only if your IB, A-level or AP result is within a set score range. Otherwise you need a C1 certificate in the language of instruction: IELTS 7.0+, TOEFL iBT 5.0+ (new 1–6 scale), Duolingo 130+ or another C1 certificate (TestDAF, DELF, HSK, TÖMER, etc.).

    I didn’t take the DİM exam. Is there a way?

    Yes. 75% or more of the maximum SAT or ACT score (SAT 1200+, ACT 27+), an international olympiad medal, or IB / A-level / AP results replace the DİM requirement. If you go with DİM: at least 400 in technical, natural science, health and agriculture fields, and 550 in other fields.

    Which costs are covered?

    Tuition fees, visa and registration, monthly living costs (at a set rate per country), health insurance, international flights and bank/card fees. Payments are made with the "DP 2022–2028 Scholarship Card"; the card is activated after documents confirming you’ve started your studies.

    Are a foundation year or language courses covered?

    No. Preparatory (foundation) and language courses aren’t funded. The programme also isn’t responsible for any amount you pay the university to get your offer letter. However, tuition fees you’ve paid yourself for the current academic year are refunded after admission.

    Can it be an online or part-time programme?

    No. Only traditional full-time (offline) programmes are funded. Executive, distance, online and non-degree programmes aren’t accepted. A joint degree is accepted only if all partner universities are on the list.

    I’m already at university. Can I apply?

    If you’re studying abroad, you can apply for funding of the remaining part, as long as no more than half of the standard programme length has passed. If you’re studying in Azerbaijan, you need to get a new offer for year 1 abroad; some universities count the years you’ve completed in Azerbaijan (see the university routes in your test result).

    Is there an age limit?

    No, there’s no age criterion. But people who have already completed studies at the same level (for example, who did a state-funded Master’s) can’t apply again for that level.

    How does the interview work?

    Candidates whose documents are accepted are invited to an interview. A commission of at least 3 people (the Ministry, the State Oil Fund, state bodies) assesses your subject knowledge, logical thinking, communication and self-confidence; the interview is held in Azerbaijani and/or the language of instruction and is recorded on audio and video. If places are limited, olympiad winners are ranked first, then everyone else by final score. Olympiad medallists are exempt from the interview.

    Is there a commitment after my studies?

    Bachelor’s and Master’s students sign a contract with the Ministry. PhD candidates also commit to working at a university in Azerbaijan for at least 5 years after their studies (notarised statement + consent letter from the local university). If you fall behind academically, funding is paused until you catch up.

    Can I take my family with me? Are there any concessions?

    Living, transport, insurance and visa costs for family members aren’t covered, and the scholarship isn’t increased. There are no concessions or privileges based on social status (internally displaced person, family of a martyr, etc.).

    What is the "Top-10 university" exception?

    Programmes not on the list are also funded at universities in the top 10 of the THE, QS or ARWU rankings (except UCL). Rankings change every year; this group usually includes Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial, Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Caltech, Princeton, Yale, Columbia, Chicago, Penn, ETH Zürich and NUS. This route is the main option for majors not on the list (for example, law or politics), but the admission requirements are very high.

    Is EDDE Global a partner of the State Programme?

    No. The Ministry doesn’t work with study-abroad companies. EDDE Global helps you with choosing a university, admission, language preparation, preparing your DP documents and getting ready for the interview; you apply to the State Programme yourself on portal.edu.az. Official information: dp.edu.az.
